desc.en: How each piece moves. Land on stars, capture targets — fewer moves, more points.
desc.fr: Comment chaque pièce se déplace. Atteignez les étoiles, capturez les cibles — moins de coups, plus de points.
desc.ar: كيف تتحرك كل قطعة. اجمع النجوم والتقط القطع — كلما قلّت النقلات زادت النقاط.

desc.en: Castling, en passant, and promotion — the moves that surprise beginners.
desc.fr: Roque, prise en passant et promotion — les coups qui surprennent.
desc.ar: التحصين والأخذ في المرور والترقية — نقلات تفاجئ المبتدئين.

desc.en: Attack the king: check, the game-ending checkmate, and the drawing stalemate.
desc.fr: Attaquez le roi : échec, mat et patt.
desc.ar: هاجم الملك: الكش والكش مات والجمود.

desc.en: Win material with hanging pieces, pins, and discovered attacks.
desc.fr: Gagnez du matériel avec les pièces pendantes, les pins et les attaques découvertes.
desc.ar: اربح القطع عبر القطع المعلقة والتثبيت والهجوم المكتشف.

desc.en: Develop pieces, fight for the center, place rooks well, push pawns.
desc.fr: Développez vos pièces, luttez pour le centre, placez vos tours, poussez vos pions.
desc.ar: طوّر قطعك وسيطر على المركز ووضع الرخوص وأبعد البيادق.

desc.en: King + pawn, rook endings, and how to save a lost game.
desc.fr: Roi + pion, finales de tours, et comment sauver une partie perdue.
desc.ar: الملك والبيدق ونهايات الرخوص وكيف تُنقذ لعبة خاسرة.

desc.en: Straight lines, any distance — land on every star.
Diagonals forever — one color, endless reach.
desc.ar: قطرات لا تنتهي — لون واحد ونطاق واسع.

desc.en: Rook + bishop in one — the most powerful piece.
One square at a time — but it rules the board.
The L-jumper — the only piece that leaps.
Small but mighty — captures diagonally, promotes to anything.
One move that guards the king and activates a rook.
desc.fr: Un coup pour protéger le roi.
desc.ar: نقلة واحدة تحمي الملك وتحرّك الرخ.

desc.en: Capture a pawn the instant it tries to slip past.
A pawn on the last rank becomes any piece.
desc.fr: Le pion devient n'importe quelle pièce.
desc.ar: البيدق في الرتبة الأخيرة يصبح أي قطعة.

desc.en: Attack the king — it must respond at once.
desc.ar: هاجم الملك — لا بد من الرد فورًا.

desc.en: Check with no escape — the game ends.
No moves, no check — half a point saved.
desc.ar: لا نقلات ولا كش — يُنقذ نصف نقطة.

desc.en: Undefended enemy pieces are free material.
desc.fr: Les pièces non défendues sont gratuites.

desc.en: Trap a piece against something precious behind it.
Skewers, forks, deflection & more — lessons in the workshop.
Wake your pieces up before the fight begins.
Central pawns = space, scope, and options.
Open files and the 7th rank — rook highways.
Passed pawns race to promotion.
desc.fr: Les pions passants courent à la promotion.

desc.en: In the endgame, the king joins the attack.
desc.fr: En finale, le roi se bat.
desc.ar: في النهاية يشارك الملك في القتال.

desc.en: Push the passed pawn home — the simplest win.
Activity rules: hunt pawns, deliver the ladder mate.
desc.ar: النشاط هو الأهم: اصطد البيادق وأكمل السلّم.

desc.en: Stalemate tricks to save lost games.

intro.en: The rook moves in straight lines. Land on every star — the fewer moves you make, the more points you win!
intro.fr: La tour se déplace en ligne droite. Atteignez chaque étoile — moins de coups, plus de points !
intro.ar: يتحرك الرخ في خطوط مستقيمة. قف على كل نجمة — كلما قلّت نقلاتك زادت نقاطك!

goalText.en: Collect all 3 stars with the rook.
goalText.fr: Ramassez les 3 étoiles avec la tour.
goalText.ar: اجمع النجوم الثلاث بالرخ.

hints.en: Rooks travel any number of empty squares, straight only.
hints.fr: La tour parcourt autant de cases vides qu'elle veut, en ligne droite.
hints.ar: يقطع الرخ أي عدد من المربعات الفارغة في خط مستقيم.

hints.en: The whole a-file is empty — climb it star by star.
hints.fr: Toute la colonne a est vide — montez étoile par étoile.
hints.ar: العمود a فارغ تمامًا — اصعده نجمةً نجمة.

hints.en: Play a4, then a6, then a8.
hints.fr: Jouez a4, puis a6, puis a8.
hints.ar: العب a4 ثم a6 ثم a8.

explain.en: One star per landing: passing over a star does not collect it.
explain.fr: Une étoile par arrivée : passer au-dessus ne suffit pas.
explain.ar: نجمة واحدة عند الوقوف: المرور فوق النجمة لا يجمعها.

success.en: 3 stars in 3 moves — perfect rook control!

failHint.en: Count your landings: each star needs its own stop.
failHint.fr: Comptez vos arrivées : chaque étoile demande son arrêt.
failHint.ar: احسب وقفاتك: كل نجمة تحتاج توقفًا.

goalText.en: Collect all 3 stars. Your own king blocks the first rank!
goalText.fr: Ramassez les 3 étoiles. Votre propre roi bloque la première rangée !
goalText.ar: اجمع النجوم الثلاث. ملكك يعترض الصف الأول!

hints.en: Your king on e1 blocks sliding along rank 1.
hints.fr: Votre roi en e1 bloque le passage sur la rangée 1.
hints.ar: ملكك في e1 يسد الطريق على الصف الأول.

hints.en: Go up the a-file first, then turn.
hints.fr: Montez d'abord la colonne a, puis tournez.
hints.ar: اصعد العمود a أولًا ثم انعطف.

hints.en: Play a8, h8, h1.
hints.fr: Jouez a8, h8, h1.
hints.ar: العب a8 ثم h8 ثم h1.

explain.en: Rooks turn corners by combining two straight slides. Friendly pieces block too.
explain.fr: La tour tourne en combinant deux glissades droites. Les pièces amies bloquent aussi.
explain.ar: ينعطف الرخ بجمع حركتين مستقيمتين. القطع الصديقة تعترض أيضًا.

success.en: Three corners turned — the rook dances!

failHint.en: The e1 king forces the a-file route. Up, across, down.
failHint.fr: Le roi e1 impose la colonne a. Haut, traversée, bas.
failHint.ar: ملك e1 يفرض طريق العمود a. اصعد ثم اعبر ثم انزل.

goalText.en: Your pawn on a6 blocks the file. Collect both stars anyway.
goalText.fr: Votre pion en a6 bloque la colonne. Ramassez les étoiles quand même.
goalText.ar: بيدقك في a6 يسد العمود. اجمع النجمتين رغم ذلك.

hints.en: The a6 pawn splits the file in two — detour around it.
hints.fr: Le pion a6 coupe la colonne en deux — contournez-le.
hints.ar: البيدق a6 يقسم العمود — التفّ حوله.

hints.en: Collect a4 first, then leave the file sideways.
hints.fr: Prenez a4 d'abord, puis quittez la colonne.
hints.ar: اجمع a4 أولًا ثم اخرج من العمود جانبًا.

hints.en: Play a4, e4, e8, a8.
hints.fr: Jouez a4, e4, e8, a8.
hints.ar: العب a4 ثم e4 ثم e8 ثم a8.

explain.en: When the direct road is blocked, a rook goes around the obstacle in a rectangle.
explain.fr: Quand la route directe est bloquée, la tour contourne l'obstacle en rectangle.
explain.ar: عندما يُسد الطريق المباشر يلتف الرخ حول العائق مستطيلًا.

success.en: Detour mastered — blockers are just puzzles!
success.fr: Détour maîtrisé — les bloqueurs ne sont que des énigmes !

failHint.en: a6 can't be crossed. Rectangle: out, up, back.
failHint.fr: a6 est infranchissable. Rectangle : sortie, montée, retour.
failHint.ar: لا يمكن عبور a6. مستطيل: اخرج ثم اصعد ثم عُد.

goalText.en: Capture all 3 black pawns.
goalText.fr: Capturez les 3 pions noirs.
goalText.ar: التقط البيادق السوداء الثلاثة.

hints.en: Rooks capture exactly like they move: land on the enemy.
hints.fr: La tour capture comme elle se déplace : en arrivant sur l'ennemi.
hints.ar: يلتقط الرخ كما يتحرك: بالوقوف على العدو.

hints.en: Start with the closest pawn, a5.
hints.fr: Commencez par le pion le plus proche, a5.
hints.ar: ابدأ بالبيدق الأقرب a5.

hints.en: Play axa5, a5–e5, exxe8.
hints.fr: Jouez axa5, a5–e5, exxe8.
hints.ar: العب axa5 ثم a5–e5 ثم exxe8.

explain.en: Chain captures along shared lines: each capture lands you lined up for the next.
explain.fr: Enchaînez les captures sur des lignes partagées : chaque prise vous aligne pour la suivante.
explain.ar: سلسِل الالتقاط على خطوط مشتركة: كل التقاط يضعك على خط التالي.

success.en: Three pawns swept off the board!

failHint.en: Follow the chain a5 → e5 → e8.
failHint.fr: Suivez la chaîne a5 → e5 → e8.
failHint.ar: اتبع السلسلة a5 ← e5 ← e8.

goalText.en: Reach h8. The marked squares are lava — never cross or land on them.
goalText.fr: Atteignez h8. Les cases marquées sont de la lave — ne les traversez ni n'y arrêtez.
goalText.ar: اصِل إلى h8. المربعات المعلّمة حمم — لا تعبرها ولا تقف عليها.

hints.en: a8 and h1 are lava. Both 2-move roads use them.
hints.fr: a8 et h1 sont de la lave. Les deux routes en 2 coups les utilisent.
hints.ar: a8 وh1 حمم. الطريقان ذات النقلتين يمران بهما.

hints.en: Climb the d-file instead.
hints.fr: Montez plutôt par la colonne d.
hints.ar: اصعد من العمود d بدلًا من ذلك.

hints.en: Play d1, d8, h8.
hints.fr: Jouez d1, d8, h8.
hints.ar: العب d1 ثم d8 ثم h8.

explain.en: Obstacles turn roads off: always re-check which 2-move tries survive.
explain.fr: Les obstacles ferment des routes : revérifiez quelles tentatives en 2 coups survivent.
explain.ar: العوائق تغلق الطرق: أعد فحص محاولات النقلتين الناجية.

success.ar: نجوت من الحمم — فتحت تخطيط الطرق!

failHint.en: a8 and h1 burn. The d-file road is safe.
failHint.fr: a8 et h1 brûlent. La route de la colonne d est sûre.
failHint.ar: a8 وh1 تحرقان. طريق العمود d آمن.

goalText.en: Collect all 4 stars. Plan the whole tour before moving!
goalText.fr: Ramassez les 4 étoiles. Planifiez tout le parcours avant de jouer !
goalText.ar: اجمع النجوم الأربع. خطط الجولة كاملة قبل الحركة!

hints.en: Four stars, so at least 4 landings — plus getting started.
hints.fr: Quatre étoiles, donc au moins 4 arrivées — plus le départ.
hints.ar: أربع نجوم أي أربع وقفات على الأقل — زائد البداية.

hints.en: Sweep the bottom rank, then climb the b-file.
hints.fr: Balayez la rangée du bas, puis montez la colonne b.
hints.ar: امسح الصف السفلي ثم اصعد العمود b.

hints.en: One road: h1, h2, b2, b7, h7.
hints.fr: Une route : h1, h2, b2, b7, h7.
hints.ar: طريق واحد: h1 ثم h2 ثم b2 ثم b7 ثم h7.

explain.en: Shortest routes chain shared lines: each landing sets up the next.
explain.fr: Les routes les plus courtes enchaînent des lignes partagées : chaque arrivée prépare la suivante.
explain.ar: أقصر الطرق تسلسل خطوطًا مشتركة: كل وقفة تجهّز التالية.

success.en: Grand tour in 5 — true rook vision!
success.fr: Grand tour en 5 — vraie vision de tour !
success.ar: جولة كبرى في ٥ — نظرة رخ حقيقية!

failHint.en: Order matters: h2–b2 share a rank, b2–b7 a file, b7–h7 a rank.
failHint.fr: L'ordre compte : h2–b2 partagent une rangée, b2–b7 une colonne, b7–h7 une rangée.
failHint.ar: الترتيب مهم: h2–b2 في صف واحد وb2–b7 في عمود وb7–h7 في صف.

intro.en: The bishop glides diagonally and never leaves its color. Land on every star — fewer moves, more points!
intro.fr: Le fou glisse en diagonale et ne quitte jamais sa couleur. Atteignez chaque étoile — moins de coups, plus de points !
intro.ar: ينزلق الفيل قطريًا ولا يغادر لونه أبدًا. قف على كل نجمة — كلما قلّت نقلاتك زادت نقاطك!

goalText.en: Collect both stars with the bishop.
goalText.fr: Ramassez les 2 étoiles avec le fou.
goalText.ar: اجمع النجمتين بالفيل.

hints.en: Bishops own diagonals — c1, d2, e3, f4, g5, h6 is one line.
hints.fr: Les fous règnent sur les diagonales — c1, d2, e3, f4, g5, h6 forment une ligne.
hints.ar: الفيلة تملك الأقطار — c1 وd2 وe3 وf4 وg5 وh6 خط واحد.

hints.en: Both stars sit on that diagonal.
hints.fr: Les deux étoiles sont sur cette diagonale.
hints.ar: النجمتان على هذا القطر.

hints.en: Play e3, then g5 — or g5, then e3.
hints.fr: Jouez e3, puis g5 — ou g5, puis e3.
hints.ar: العب e3 ثم g5 — أو g5 ثم e3.

explain.en: Landing collects the star; gliding over it does not.
explain.fr: L'arrivée ramasse l'étoile ; la survoler ne suffit pas.
explain.ar: الوقوف يجمع النجمة؛ المرور فوقها لا يكفي.

failHint.en: Stay on the c1–h6 diagonal: e3 and g5.
failHint.fr: Restez sur la diagonale c1–h6 : e3 et g5.
failHint.ar: ابقَ على قطر c1–h6: e3 وg5.

goalText.en: Collect all 3 stars across both diagonals.
goalText.fr: Ramassez les 3 étoiles sur les deux diagonales.
goalText.ar: اجمع النجوم الثلاثة على القطرين.

hints.en: From c1 the bishop reaches two diagonals: b2–a3 and d2–h6.
hints.fr: Depuis c1 le fou atteint deux diagonales : b2–a3 et d2–h6.
hints.ar: من c1 يصل الفيل إلى قطرين: b2–a3 وd2–h6.

hints.en: Clear the short diagonal first.
hints.fr: Nettoyez d'abord la petite diagonale.
hints.ar: نظّف القطر القصير أولًا.

hints.en: Play b2, a3, then swing up to e7.
hints.fr: Jouez b2, a3, puis remontez vers e7.
hints.ar: العب b2 ثم a3 ثم اصعد إلى e7.

explain.en: Every bishop move switches diagonals — plan which diagonal each star needs.
explain.fr: Chaque coup de fou change de diagonale — prévoyez la diagonale de chaque étoile.
explain.ar: كل نقلة فيل تغيّر القطر — خطط لقطر كل نجمة.

failHint.en: b2 and a3 share one diagonal; e7 needs the long a3–f8 road.
failHint.fr: b2 et a3 partagent une diagonale ; e7 exige la longue route a3–f8.
failHint.ar: b2 وa3 على قطر واحد؛ e7 يحتاج طريق a3–f8 الطويل.

goalText.en: Your pawn on d2 blocks the main diagonal. Collect both stars anyway.
goalText.fr: Votre pion en d2 bloque la grande diagonale. Ramassez les étoiles quand même.
goalText.ar: بيدقك في d2 يسد القطر الرئيسي. اجمع النجمتين رغم ذلك.

hints.en: d2 is occupied, so c1 can't go right — go left first.
hints.fr: d2 est occupée, c1 ne peut pas aller à droite — allez à gauche d'abord.
hints.ar: d2 مشغول فلا يستطيع c1 الذهاب يمينًا — اذهب يسارًا أولًا.

hints.en: The a3–f8 diagonal climbs back to the kingside.
hints.fr: La diagonale a3–f8 remonte vers l'aile roi.
hints.ar: قطر a3–f8 يصعد عائدًا إلى جناح الملك.

hints.en: Play a3, f8, h6, then drop to f4.
hints.fr: Jouez a3, f8, h6, puis redescendez en f4.
hints.ar: العب a3 ثم f8 ثم h6 ثم انزل إلى f4.

explain.en: A blocked diagonal means leaving by the other one and returning from above.
explain.fr: Une diagonale bloquée impose de sortir par l'autre et de revenir par le haut.
explain.ar: القطر المسدود يعني الخروج من الآخر والعودة من الأعلى.

failHint.en: Left, up, across, down: a3, f8, h6, f4.
failHint.fr: Gauche, haut, traversée, bas : a3, f8, h6, f4.
failHint.ar: يسار ثم صعود ثم عبور ثم نزول: a3 وf8 وh6 وf4.

goalText.en: Capture all 3 black pawns.
goalText.fr: Capturez les 3 pions noirs.
goalText.ar: التقط البيادق السوداء الثلاثة.

hints.en: Captures land you on new diagonals — chain them.
hints.fr: Les captures vous posent sur de nouvelles diagonales — enchaînez-les.
hints.ar: الالتقاط يضعك على أقطار جديدة — سلسِلها.

hints.en: The b2 pawn is closest to home.
hints.fr: Le pion b2 est le plus proche.
hints.ar: بيدق b2 هو الأقرب.

hints.en: Play xbxb2, back to c1, xxe3, xxg5.
hints.fr: Jouez xbxb2, retour en c1, xxe3, xxg5.
hints.ar: العب xbxb2 ثم عُد إلى c1 ثم xxe3 ثم xxg5.

explain.en: Each capture is also a redeployment onto the next diagonal.
explain.fr: Chaque capture est aussi un redéploiement sur la diagonale suivante.
explain.ar: كل التقاط هو أيضًا إعادة انتشار على القطر التالي.

success.en: Three pawns picked off the diagonals!
success.fr: Trois pions cueillis sur les diagonales !

failHint.en: Order: b2 first, swing home, then climb e3–g5.
failHint.fr: Ordre : b2 d'abord, retour, puis montée e3–g5.
failHint.ar: الترتيب: b2 أولًا ثم العودة ثم الصعود e3–g5.

goalText.en: g5 is lava — it blocks the direct road to h6. Collect all 3 stars.
goalText.fr: g5 est de la lave — elle bloque la route directe vers h6. Ramassez les 3 étoiles.
goalText.ar: g5 حمم — تسد الطريق المباشر إلى h6. اجمع النجوم الثلاث.

hints.en: c1–h6 crosses g5, which burns. Go the long way round.
hints.fr: c1–h6 traverse g5, qui brûle. Faites le grand tour.
hints.ar: c1–h6 يعبر g5 الحارقة. سِر الطريق الطويل.

hints.en: Grab b2 and a3 on the way out.
hints.fr: Prenez b2 et a3 en sortant.
hints.ar: اجمع b2 وa3 في طريقك للخارج.

hints.en: Play b2, a3, f8, h6.
hints.fr: Jouez b2, a3, f8, h6.
hints.ar: العب b2 ثم a3 ثم f8 ثم h6.

explain.en: One blocked square can force a three-diagonal journey.
explain.fr: Une seule case bloquée peut imposer un voyage en trois diagonales.
explain.ar: مربع مسدود واحد قد يفرض رحلة بثلاثة أقطار.

success.fr: Lave traversée sans dommage — expert du détour !

failHint.en: Never touch g5: b2, a3, f8, h6.
failHint.fr: Ne touchez jamais g5 : b2, a3, f8, h6.
failHint.ar: لا تلمس g5 أبدًا: b2 ثم a3 ثم f8 ثم h6.

title.fr: Fou : le grand tour des diagonales

goalText.en: Collect all 4 stars. Plan the whole tour first!
goalText.fr: Ramassez les 4 étoiles. Planifiez tout le parcours d'abord !
goalText.ar: اجمع النجوم الأربع. خطط الجولة كاملة أولًا!

hints.en: Four stars on two clusters: the c1 side and the a3 side.
hints.fr: Quatre étoiles en deux groupes : côté c1 et côté a3.
hints.ar: أربع نجوم في مجموعتين: جهة c1 وجهة a3.

hints.en: Finish one cluster before crossing to the other.
hints.fr: Terminez un groupe avant de passer à l'autre.
hints.ar: أنهِ مجموعة قبل العبور إلى الأخرى.

hints.en: One road: f4, h6, c1, a3, e7.
hints.fr: Une route : f4, h6, c1, a3, e7.
hints.ar: طريق واحد: f4 ثم h6 ثم c1 ثم a3 ثم e7.

explain.en: Cluster your targets: crossings between clusters cost extra moves.
explain.fr: Regroupez vos cibles : les traversées entre groupes coûtent des coups.
explain.ar: جمّع أهدافك: العبور بين المجموعات يكلّف نقلات.

success.fr: Grand tour en 5 — maîtrise des diagonales !

failHint.en: f4–h6 share a road, a3–e7 share one. Cross once, in c1.
failHint.fr: f4–h6 partagent une route, a3–e7 aussi. Traversez une fois, en c1.
failHint.ar: f4–h6 على طريق واحد وa3–e7 كذلك. اعبر مرة واحدة عبر c1.

intro.en: The queen moves like a rook PLUS a bishop. Land on every star — the fewer moves, the more points!
intro.fr: La dame se déplace comme une tour PLUS un fou. Atteignez chaque étoile — moins de coups, plus de points !
intro.ar: تتحرك الملكة مثل الرخ والفيل معًا. قف على كل نجمة — كلما قلّت نقلاتك زادت نقاطك!

goalText.en: Collect all 3 stars with the queen.
goalText.fr: Ramassez les 3 étoiles avec la dame.
goalText.ar: اجمع النجوم الثلاث بالملكة.

hints.en: The whole d-file is empty.
hints.fr: Toute la colonne d est vide.
hints.ar: العمود d فارغ تمامًا.

hints.en: Climb it star by star.
hints.fr: Montez étoile par étoile.
hints.ar: اصعده نجمةً نجمة.

hints.en: Play d4, d6, d8.
hints.fr: Jouez d4, d6, d8.
hints.ar: العب d4 ثم d6 ثم d8.

explain.en: Queen power means options — but one star still needs one landing.
explain.fr: La puissance de la dame offre des options — mais chaque étoile exige son arrivée.
explain.ar: قوة الملكة تعني خيارات — لكن كل نجمة تحتاج وقفة.

failHint.en: Straight up the d-file: d4, d6, d8.
failHint.fr: Tout droit sur la colonne d : d4, d6, d8.
failHint.ar: مباشرة في العمود d: d4 ثم d6 ثم d8.

title.en: Queen: rook and bishop in one
title.fr: Dame : tour et fou en une

goalText.en: Collect all 3 stars using both queen powers.
goalText.fr: Ramassez les 3 étoiles en utilisant les deux pouvoirs.
goalText.ar: اجمع النجوم الثلاث باستخدام القوتين.

hints.en: Start with the bishop-move: the d1–h5 diagonal.
hints.fr: Commencez par le coup de fou : la diagonale d1–h5.
hints.ar: ابدأ بحركة الفيل: قطر d1–h5.

hints.en: Then slide like a rook along rank 5 and file a.
hints.fr: Puis glissez comme une tour sur la rangée 5 et la colonne a.
hints.ar: ثم انزلق كالرخ على الصف الخامس والعمود a.

hints.en: Play h5, a5, a8.
hints.fr: Jouez h5, a5, a8.
hints.ar: العب h5 ثم a5 ثم a8.

explain.en: Diagonal, rank, file — one tour uses every queen power.
explain.fr: Diagonale, rangée, colonne — un parcours utilise tous les pouvoirs.
explain.ar: قطر وصف وعمود — جولة واحدة تستخدم كل القوى.

failHint.en: Bishop first (h5), then rook slides (a5, a8).
failHint.fr: Fou d'abord (h5), puis glissades de tour (a5, a8).
failHint.ar: الفيل أولًا (h5) ثم انزلاقات الرخ (a5 وa8).

goalText.en: Your pawn on d4 blocks the file. Collect both stars anyway.
goalText.fr: Votre pion en d4 bloque la colonne. Ramassez les étoiles quand même.
goalText.ar: بيدقك في d4 يسد العمود. اجمع النجمتين رغم ذلك.

hints.en: d4 is occupied, so leave the file and come back from above.
hints.fr: d4 est occupée : quittez la colonne et revenez par le haut.
hints.ar: d4 مشغول: اخرج من العمود وعُد من الأعلى.

hints.en: The h5 square starts a road back to d5.
hints.fr: La case h5 ouvre une route vers d5.
hints.ar: المربع h5 يفتح طريقًا إلى d5.

hints.en: Play h5, d5, d6, d8.
hints.fr: Jouez h5, d5, d6, d8.
hints.ar: العب h5 ثم d5 ثم d6 ثم d8.

explain.en: Queens detour like rooks when blocked — out, across, up, back.
explain.fr: Bloquée, la dame contourne comme une tour — sortie, traversée, montée, retour.
explain.ar: عند الانسداد تلتف الملكة كالرخ — خروج وعبور وصعود وعودة.

failHint.en: Around, not through: h5, d5, d6, d8.
failHint.fr: Autour, pas à travers : h5, d5, d6, d8.
failHint.ar: حوله لا خلاله: h5 ثم d5 ثم d6 ثم d8.

goalText.en: Capture all 3 black pawns. Your g4 pawn guards the shortcut.
goalText.fr: Capturez les 3 pions noirs. Votre pion g4 garde le raccourci.
goalText.ar: التقط البيادق السوداء الثلاثة. بيدقك g4 يحرس الطريق المختصر.

hints.en: The d1–h5 diagonal is guarded by your own g4 pawn.
hints.fr: La diagonale d1–h5 est gardée par votre propre pion g4.
hints.ar: قطر d1–h5 يحرسه بيدقك g4.

hints.en: Climb the d-file eating as you go.
hints.fr: Montez la colonne d en mangeant au passage.
hints.ar: اصعد العمود d آكلًا في طريقك.

hints.en: Play xd5, xd7, h7, xxh5.
hints.fr: Jouez xd5, xd7, h7, xxh5.
hints.ar: العب xd5 ثم xd7 ثم h7 ثم xxh5.

explain.en: Even queens take the stairs when the elevator is guarded.
explain.fr: Même les dames prennent l'escalier quand l'ascenseur est gardé.
explain.ar: حتى الملكات تصعد الدرج عندما يكون المصعد محروسًا.

failHint.en: Up the file first: d5, d7, then swing to h5.
failHint.fr: D'abord la colonne : d5, d7, puis vers h5.
failHint.ar: العمود أولًا: d5 ثم d7 ثم نحو h5.

goalText.en: Reach h8. Three 2-move roads are lava — find the 3-move road.
goalText.fr: Atteignez h8. Trois routes en 2 coups sont de la lave — trouvez celle en 3 coups.
goalText.ar: اصِل إلى h8. ثلاثة طرق بنقلتين حمم — جد طريق النقلات الثلاث.

hints.en: h1, d8 and h5 each kill one 2-move road.
hints.fr: h1, d8 et h5 tuent chacune une route en 2 coups.
hints.ar: h1 وd8 وh5 تقتل كل منها طريق نقلتين.

hints.en: The a-file road survives.
hints.fr: La route de la colonne a survit.
hints.ar: طريق العمود a ناجٍ.

hints.en: Play a1, a8, h8.
hints.fr: Jouez a1, a8, h8.
hints.ar: العب a1 ثم a8 ثم h8.

explain.en: Eliminate the blocked roads first; the survivor is your route.
explain.fr: Éliminez d'abord les routes bloquées ; la survivante est votre route.
explain.ar: استبعد الطرق المسدودة أولًا؛ الناجي هو طريقك.

failHint.en: h1, d8, h5 burn — go a1, a8, h8.
failHint.fr: h1, d8, h5 brûlent — passez par a1, a8, h8.
failHint.ar: h1 وd8 وh5 تحرق — سِر a1 ثم a8 ثم h8.

goalText.en: Collect all 5 stars in one royal circuit.
goalText.fr: Ramassez les 5 étoiles en un circuit royal.
goalText.ar: اجمع النجوم الخمس في دائرة ملكية واحدة.

hints.en: Five stars need five landings — no wasted transit allowed.
hints.fr: Cinq étoiles exigent cinq arrivées — aucun transit perdu.
hints.ar: خمس نجوم تحتاج خمس وقفات — لا عبور ضائع.

hints.en: Diagonal out, then sweep the edges home.
hints.fr: Diagonale de sortie, puis balayez les bords.
hints.ar: قطر للخروج ثم امسح الحواف عائدًا.

hints.en: One circuit: h5, a5, a8, h8, e8.
hints.fr: Un circuit : h5, a5, a8, h8, e8.
hints.ar: دائرة واحدة: h5 ثم a5 ثم a8 ثم h8 ثم e8.

explain.en: Five targets, five landings: every move must collect.
explain.fr: Cinq cibles, cinq arrivées : chaque coup doit ramasser.
explain.ar: خمسة أهداف وخمس وقفات: كل نقلة يجب أن تجمع.

failHint.en: h5–a5–a8–h8–e8: never land empty.
failHint.fr: h5–a5–a8–h8–e8 : ne vous arrêtez jamais à vide.
failHint.ar: h5–a5–a8–h8–e8: لا تقف فارغًا أبدًا.

title.en: King: one step at a time
title.fr: Roi : un pas à la fois

intro.en: The king moves exactly one square in any direction. Collect the stairs — slow and safe wins!
intro.fr: Le roi avance d'exactement une case dans toute direction. Ramassez l'escalier — doucement et sûrement !
intro.ar: يتحرك الملك مربعًا واحدًا فقط في أي اتجاه. اجمع الدرج — البطء والأمان يفوزان!

goalText.en: Climb the stairs: collect all 3 stars.
goalText.fr: Montez l'escalier : ramassez les 3 étoiles.
goalText.ar: اصعد الدرج: اجمع النجوم الثلاث.

hints.en: One square per move — no rushing, even for kings.
hints.fr: Une case par coup — pas de précipitation, même pour les rois.
hints.ar: مربع واحد كل نقلة — لا استعجال حتى للملوك.

hints.en: Straight up the e-file.
hints.fr: Tout droit sur la colonne e.
hints.ar: مباشرة في العمود e.

hints.en: Play e2, e3, e4.
hints.fr: Jouez e2, e3, e4.
hints.ar: العب e2 ثم e3 ثم e4.

explain.en: Three stairs, three steps: the king's pace sets the par.
explain.fr: Trois marches, trois pas : le rythme du roi fixe le par.
explain.ar: ثلاث درجات وثلاث خطوات: إيقاع الملك يحدد العدد.

success.en: Steady climb — a careful king lives long!
success.fr: Montée tranquille — un roi prudent vit longtemps !
success.ar: صعود ثابت — الملك الحذر يعيش طويلًا!

failHint.en: Up, up, up: e2, e3, e4.
failHint.fr: Haut, haut, haut : e2, e3, e4.
failHint.ar: اصعد اصعد اصعد: e2 ثم e3 ثم e4.

goalText.en: Collect all 3 stars around the corner.
goalText.fr: Ramassez les 3 étoiles autour du coin.
goalText.ar: اجمع النجوم الثلاث حول الزاوية.

hints.en: The king turns corners one square at a time.
hints.fr: Le roi tourne les coins une case à la fois.
hints.ar: ينعطف الملك مربعًا مربعًا.

hints.en: Left, up, right.
hints.fr: Gauche, haut, droite.
hints.ar: يسار ثم صعود ثم يمين.

hints.en: Play d1, d2, e2.
hints.fr: Jouez d1, d2, e2.
hints.ar: العب d1 ثم d2 ثم e2.

explain.en: Kings zigzag: every neighboring square is one move away.
explain.fr: Les rois zigzaguent : chaque case voisine est à un coup.
explain.ar: الملوك تتحرك متعرجة: كل مربع مجاور على بعد نقلة.

failHint.en: d1, then d2, then e2.
failHint.fr: d1, puis d2, puis e2.
failHint.ar: d1 ثم d2 ثم e2.

title.en: King: the pawn in the way

goalText.en: Your pawn on e2 blocks the stairs. Reach e4 anyway.
goalText.fr: Votre pion en e2 bloque l'escalier. Atteignez e4 quand même.
goalText.ar: بيدقك في e2 يسد الدرج. اصِل إلى e4 رغم ذلك.

hints.en: e2 is occupied — step around your own pawn.
hints.fr: e2 est occupée — contournez votre propre pion.
hints.ar: e2 مشغول — التفّ حول بيدقك.

hints.en: Sidestep to d2 first.
hints.fr: Écartez-vous en d2 d'abord.
hints.ar: انحرف إلى d2 أولًا.

hints.en: Play d2, e3, e4.
hints.fr: Jouez d2, e3, e4.
hints.ar: العب d2 ثم e3 ثم e4.

explain.en: Friendly pieces block too — sidestep and rejoin the road.
explain.fr: Les pièces amies bloquent aussi — écartez-vous et rejoignez la route.
explain.ar: القطع الصديقة تعترض أيضًا — انحرف وعُد إلى الطريق.

failHint.en: Around the pawn: d2, e3, e4.
failHint.fr: Autour du pion : d2, e3, e4.
failHint.ar: حول البيدق: d2 ثم e3 ثم e4.

goalText.en: Capture both black pawns. Pawns defend each other — take the lonely one first!
goalText.fr: Capturez les deux pions noirs. Les pions se défendent — prenez le solitaire d'abord !
goalText.ar: التقط البيدقين الأسودين. البيادق تحمي بعضها — خذ المنعزل أولًا!

hints.en: d2 is undefended — but f3 is watched by no one either. Start close.
hints.fr: d2 est sans défense — f3 non plus. Commencez près.
hints.ar: d2 بلا حماية — وf3 أيضًا. ابدأ من القريب.

hints.en: After xd2, step to e3 to reach f3.
hints.fr: Après xd2, passez par e3 pour atteindre f3.
hints.ar: بعد xd2 مر عبر e3 لتصل f3.

hints.en: Play xd2, e3, xf3.
hints.fr: Jouez xd2, e3, xf3.
hints.ar: العب xd2 ثم e3 ثم xf3.

explain.en: Never capture a defended piece with your king — take the free one, then step over.
explain.fr: Ne capturez jamais une pièce défendue avec le roi — prenez la gratuite, puis avancez.
explain.ar: لا تلتقط أبدًا قطعة محمية بملكك — خذ الحرة ثم تقدّم.

failHint.en: xd2 first (it's free), transit e3, then xf3.
failHint.fr: xd2 d'abord (gratuit), transit e3, puis xf3.
failHint.ar: xd2 أولًا (مجاني) ثم عبور e3 ثم xf3.

goalText.en: The bishop covers e2 and f1 — a king may never enter danger. Collect both stars.
goalText.fr: Le fou couvre e2 et f1 — un roi n'entre jamais en danger. Ramassez les étoiles.
goalText.ar: الفيل يغطي e2 وf1 — الملك لا يدخل الخطر أبدًا. اجمع النجمتين.

hints.en: e2 and f1 are attacked — the level rejects them.
hints.fr: e2 et f1 sont attaquées — le niveau les refuse.
hints.ar: e2 وf1 مهددتان — المستوى يرفضهما.

hints.en: Safe roads only: d2 is safe, and so is f2.
hints.fr: Routes sûres uniquement : d2 est sûre, f2 aussi.
hints.ar: الطرق الآمنة فقط: d2 آمن وf2 آمن.

hints.en: Play d2, e3, f2 — or f2, e3, d2.
hints.fr: Jouez d2, e3, f2 — ou f2, e3, d2.
hints.ar: العب d2 ثم e3 ثم f2 — أو f2 ثم e3 ثم d2.

explain.en: Kings never step onto attacked squares — the rule is built into every king move.
explain.fr: Les rois ne vont jamais sur des cases attaquées — la règle est dans chaque coup de roi.
explain.ar: الملوك لا تخطو أبدًا على مربعات مهددة — القاعدة في كل حركة ملك.

success.en: Danger read perfectly — royal safety first!
success.fr: Danger lu parfaitement — sécurité royale d'abord !
success.ar: قرأت الخطر تمامًا — سلامة الملك أولًا!

failHint.en: e2 and f1 burn. Walk d2–e3–f2.
failHint.fr: e2 et f1 brûlent. Marchez d2–e3–f2.
failHint.ar: e2 وf1 تحرقان. امشِ d2–e3–f2.

goalText.en: Patrol all 4 corners of your little square. Plan the loop!
goalText.fr: Patrouillez les 4 coins de votre petit carré. Planifiez la boucle !
goalText.ar: اجُب الزوايا الأربع لمربعك الصغير. خطط الدورة!

hints.en: Four corners need four visits plus one crossing.
hints.fr: Quatre coins exigent quatre visites plus une traversée.
hints.ar: الزوايا الأربع تحتاج أربع زيارات زائد عبور.

hints.en: Sweep one side, cross over, sweep back.
hints.fr: Balayez un côté, traversez, revenez.
hints.ar: امسح جهة ثم اعبر ثم عُد.

hints.en: One loop: d1, d2, e3, f2, f1.
hints.fr: Une boucle : d1, d2, e3, f2, f1.
hints.ar: دورة واحدة: d1 ثم d2 ثم e3 ثم f2 ثم f1.

explain.en: Crossing between clusters costs a move — minimize crossings.
explain.fr: Traverser entre groupes coûte un coup — minimisez les traversées.
explain.ar: العبور بين المجموعات يكلّف نقلة — قلّل العبور.

success.en: Patrol complete in 5 — every corner salutes!
success.fr: Patrouille terminée en 5 — chaque coin salue !
success.ar: اكتملت الدورية في ٥ — كل زاوية تحيّي!

failHint.en: d1–d2, cross via e3, f2–f1.
failHint.fr: d1–d2, traversez par e3, f2–f1.
failHint.ar: d1–d2 ثم اعبر عبر e3 ثم f2–f1.

intro.en: The knight jumps in an L and over everything. Collect the stars — fewer jumps, more points!
intro.fr: Le cavalier saute en L et par-dessus tout. Ramassez les étoiles — moins de sauts, plus de points !
intro.ar: يقفز الحصان على شكل L وفوق كل شيء. اجمع النجوم — قفزات أقل تعني نقاطًا أكثر!

goalText.en: Collect both stars with the knight.
goalText.fr: Ramassez les 2 étoiles avec le cavalier.
goalText.ar: اجمع النجمتين بالحصان.

hints.en: L means two squares one way, one square sideways.
hints.fr: L signifie deux cases dans un sens, une sur le côté.
hints.ar: يعني L مربعين في اتجاه ومربعًا جانبًا.

hints.en: From g1, f3 is one L away.
hints.fr: Depuis g1, f3 est à un L.
hints.ar: من g1 تبلغ f3 بقفزة L واحدة.

hints.en: Play f3, then h4.
hints.fr: Jouez f3, puis h4.
hints.ar: العب f3 ثم h4.

explain.en: Each landing must be an L away — count two-plus-one every time.
explain.fr: Chaque arrivée doit être à un L — comptez deux-plus-un à chaque fois.
explain.ar: كل وقفة يجب أن تبعد L — احسب اثنين زائد واحد كل مرة.

success.en: Two clean Ls — the knight's dance begins!
success.fr: Deux beaux L — la danse du cavalier commence !
success.ar: حرفا L نظيفان — بدأت رقصة الحصان!

failHint.en: g1 to f3 to h4 — two Ls.
failHint.fr: g1 vers f3 vers h4 — deux L.
failHint.ar: g1 إلى f3 إلى h4 — حرفا L.

goalText.en: Zigzag up the board collecting all 3 stars.
goalText.fr: Montez en zigzag en ramassant les 3 étoiles.
goalText.ar: اصعد متعرجًا جامعًا النجوم الثلاث.

hints.en: Knights zigzag: each jump changes direction.
hints.fr: Les cavaliers zigzaguent : chaque saut change de direction.
hints.ar: الحصان يتعرج: كل قفزة تغيّر الاتجاه.

hints.en: e2 is one L from g1.
hints.fr: e2 est à un L de g1.
hints.ar: e2 على بعد L واحدة من g1.

hints.en: Play e2, f4, d5.
hints.fr: Jouez e2, f4, d5.
hints.ar: العب e2 ثم f4 ثم d5.

explain.en: Chain Ls tip-to-tail: the landing square aims the next jump.
explain.fr: Enchaînez les L bout à bout : l'arrivée vise le saut suivant.
explain.ar: سلسِل L طرفًا بطرف: مربع الوصول يوجّه القفزة التالية.

success.en: Zigzag perfect — three landings, three stars!
success.fr: Zigzag parfait — trois arrivées, trois étoiles !
success.ar: تعرج مثالي — ثلاث وقفات وثلاث نجوم!

failHint.en: e2, then f4, then d5.
failHint.fr: e2, puis f4, puis d5.
failHint.ar: e2 ثم f4 ثم d5.

goalText.en: e2 is covered — knights can't land there. Collect both stars anyway.
goalText.fr: e2 est couverte — impossible d'y atterrir. Ramassez les étoiles quand même.
goalText.ar: e2 مغطى — لا يمكن الوقوف عليه. اجمع النجمتين رغم ذلك.

hints.en: Knights jump OVER blockers — only the landing square matters.
hints.fr: Les cavaliers sautent PAR-DESSUS — seule l'arrivée compte.
hints.ar: الحصان يقفز فوق العوائق — مربع الوصول وحده يهم.

hints.en: e2 is lava for landing, but f3 is free.
hints.fr: e2 est de la lave pour atterrir, mais f3 est libre.
hints.ar: e2 حمم للوقوف لكن f3 حر.

hints.en: Play f3, then d4.
hints.fr: Jouez f3, puis d4.
hints.ar: العب f3 ثم d4.

explain.en: Nothing blocks a knight mid-jump — obstacles only deny landings.
explain.fr: Rien ne bloque un cavalier en l'air — les obstacles nient seulement les arrivées.
explain.ar: لا شيء يعترض الحصان في الهواء — العوائق تمنع الوقوف فقط.

failHint.en: Forget e2 — fly f3, then d4.
failHint.fr: Oubliez e2 — volez vers f3, puis d4.
failHint.ar: انسَ e2 — طِر إلى f3 ثم d4.

goalText.en: Capture all 3 black pawns climbing the ladder.
goalText.fr: Capturez les 3 pions noirs en montant l'échelle.
goalText.ar: التقط البيادق السوداء الثلاثة صاعدًا السلم.

hints.en: Each pawn sits exactly one L from the last.
hints.fr: Chaque pion est à exactement un L du précédent.
hints.ar: كل بيدق على بعد L واحدة من سابقه.

hints.en: Start at the bottom: f3.
hints.fr: Commencez en bas : f3.
hints.ar: ابدأ من الأسفل: f3.

hints.en: Play xxf3, xxe5, xxd7.
hints.fr: Jouez xxf3, xxe5, xxd7.
hints.ar: العب xxf3 ثم xxe5 ثم xxd7.

explain.en: Captures chain when each victim aims the next L.
explain.fr: Les captures s'enchaînent quand chaque victime vise le L suivant.
explain.ar: تتسلسل الالتقاطات عندما توجّه كل ضحية L التالية.

failHint.en: Up the ladder: f3, e5, d7.
failHint.fr: Montez l'échelle : f3, e5, d7.
failHint.ar: اصعد السلم: f3 ثم e5 ثم d7.

goalText.en: f3 looks tempting but it's lava. Collect all 3 stars the long way.
goalText.fr: f3 semble tentante mais c'est de la lave. Ramassez les étoiles par le long chemin.
goalText.ar: f3 يبدو مغريًا لكنه حمم. اجمع النجوم الثلاث بالطريق الطويل.

hints.en: f3 burns — take the quiet e2 road instead.
hints.fr: f3 brûle — prenez plutôt la route tranquille e2.
hints.ar: f3 تحرق — اسلك طريق e2 الهادئ بدلًا منها.

hints.en: e2, g3, h5 link tip-to-tail.
hints.fr: e2, g3, h5 s'enchaînent.
hints.ar: e2 وg3 وh5 تتسلسل.

hints.en: Play e2, g3, h5.
hints.fr: Jouez e2, g3, h5.
hints.ar: العب e2 ثم g3 ثم h5.

explain.en: The flashiest square is often bait — the quiet road collects more.
explain.fr: La case la plus voyante est souvent un appât — la route discrète rapporte plus.
explain.ar: المربع الأبرز غالبًا طُعم — الطريق الهادئ يجمع أكثر.

success.fr: Appât ignoré — le cavalier patient gagne !

failHint.en: Around the lava: e2, g3, h5.
failHint.fr: Autour de la lave : e2, g3, h5.
failHint.ar: حول الحمم: e2 ثم g3 ثم h5.

title.fr: Cavalier : le tour en cinq sauts

goalText.en: Collect all 5 stars. Every jump must land a star — plan it!
goalText.fr: Ramassez les 5 étoiles. Chaque saut doit rapporter — planifiez !
goalText.ar: اجمع النجوم الخمس. كل قفزة يجب أن تجمع — خطط!

hints.en: Five stars, five landings — zero transit allowed.
hints.fr: Cinq étoiles, cinq arrivées — aucun transit permis.
hints.ar: خمس نجوم وخمس وقفات — لا عبور مسموح.

hints.en: Start f3–h4 along the edge, then turn inward.
hints.fr: Commencez f3–h4 le long du bord, puis rentrez.
hints.ar: ابدأ f3–h4 على الحافة ثم ادخل.

hints.en: One tour: f3, h4, f5, e3, d5.
hints.fr: Un parcours : f3, h4, f5, e3, d5.
hints.ar: جولة واحدة: f3 ثم h4 ثم f5 ثم e3 ثم d5.

explain.en: Perfect tours never land empty: each arrival aims the next.
explain.fr: Les parcours parfaits n'arrivent jamais à vide : chaque arrivée vise la suivante.
explain.ar: الجولات المثالية لا تقف فارغة أبدًا: كل وصول يوجّه التالي.

success.en: Five jumps, five stars — knight grandmaster!
success.fr: Cinq sauts, cinq étoiles — grand maître cavalier !
success.ar: خمس قفزات وخمس نجوم — أستاذ حصان كبير!

failHint.en: f3–h4–f5–e3–d5: every landing counts.
failHint.fr: f3–h4–f5–e3–d5 : chaque arrivée compte.
failHint.ar: f3–h4–f5–e3–d5: كل وقفة محسوبة.

intro.en: Pawns march straight ahead, never back. Collect the stairs — steady pawns win points!
intro.fr: Les pions avancent tout droit, jamais en arrière. Ramassez l'escalier — les pions réguliers gagnent !
intro.ar: تتقدم البيادق للأمام فقط ولا تعود أبدًا. اجمع الدرج — البيادق الثابتة تكسب!

goalText.en: March up and collect both stars.
goalText.fr: Avancez et ramassez les deux étoiles.
goalText.ar: تقدّم واجمع النجمتين.

hints.en: Pawns step one square straight ahead.
hints.fr: Les pions avancent d'une case tout droit.
hints.ar: يتقدم البيدق مربعًا واحدًا للأمام.

hints.en: Don't double-jump: you'd skip e3 forever.
hints.fr: Pas de double saut : vous rateriez e3 pour toujours.
hints.ar: لا تقفز قفزة مزدوجة: ستفوت e3 للأبد.

hints.en: Play e3, then e4.
hints.fr: Jouez e3, puis e4.
hints.ar: العب e3 ثم e4.

explain.en: Pawns never move backward — skipped stars stay skipped.
explain.fr: Les pions ne reculent jamais — les étoiles ratées restent ratées.
explain.ar: البيادق لا تتراجع أبدًا — النجوم الفائتة تبقى فائتة.

success.en: Steady march — no star left behind!

failHint.en: One step at a time: e3, then e4.
failHint.fr: Un pas à la fois : e3, puis e4.
failHint.ar: خطوة كل مرة: e3 ثم e4.

goalText.en: Capture the pawn, then collect the star.
goalText.fr: Capturez le pion, puis ramassez l'étoile.
goalText.ar: التقط البيدق ثم اجمع النجمة.

hints.en: Pawns walk straight but capture one square diagonally.
hints.fr: Les pions marchent droit mais capturent d'une case en diagonale.
hints.ar: تمشي البيادق مستقيمة لكنها تلتقط قطريًا بمربع واحد.

hints.en: The d3 pawn stands on your diagonal.
hints.fr: Le pion d3 est sur votre diagonale.
hints.ar: بيدق d3 على قطرك.

hints.en: Play exd3, then d4.
hints.fr: Jouez exd3, puis d4.
hints.ar: العب exd3 ثم d4.

explain.en: Straight to walk, diagonal to eat — the pawn's two rules.
explain.fr: Droit pour marcher, diagonale pour manger — les deux règles du pion.
explain.ar: مستقيم للمشي وقطري للأكل — قاعدتا البيدق.

success.fr: Prendre et marcher — l'essentiel du pion !

failHint.en: Eat first (exd3), then march (d4).
failHint.fr: Mangez d'abord (exd3), puis marchez (d4).
failHint.ar: كُل أولًا (exd3) ثم تقدّم (d4).

goalText.en: An enemy pawn blocks your file. Go around it and collect both stars.
goalText.fr: Un pion ennemi bloque votre colonne. Contournez-le et ramassez les étoiles.
goalText.ar: بيدق عدو يسد عمودك. التفّ حوله واجمع النجمتين.

hints.en: e3 blocks every straight push.
hints.fr: e3 bloque toute poussée droite.
hints.ar: e3 يسد كل دفعة مستقيمة.

hints.en: But d3 is capturable — take it and switch files.
hints.fr: Mais d3 est prenable — prenez-le et changez de colonne.
hints.ar: لكن d3 قابل للالتقاط — خذه وغيّر العمود.

hints.en: Play exd3, d4, d5.
hints.fr: Jouez exd3, d4, d5.
hints.ar: العب exd3 ثم d4 ثم d5.

explain.en: A capture can change files — the pawn's only way around a wall.
explain.fr: Une capture peut changer de colonne — le seul contournement du pion.
explain.ar: الالتقاط قد يغيّر العمود — المخرج الوحيد للبيدق حول الجدار.

failHint.en: Straight is dead — capture to d3, then climb.
failHint.fr: Tout droit est mort — capturez en d3, puis montez.
failHint.ar: المستقيم ميت — التقط إلى d3 ثم اصعد.

goalText.en: Capture both black pawns.
goalText.fr: Capturez les deux pions noirs.
goalText.ar: التقط البيدقين الأسودين.

hints.en: Captures zigzag the pawn across files.
hints.fr: Les captures font zigzaguer le pion entre les colonnes.
hints.ar: الالتقاطات تجعل البيدق يتعرج بين الأعمدة.

hints.en: d2 takes c3 first.
hints.fr: d2 prend c3 d'abord.
hints.ar: d2 يأخذ c3 أولًا.

hints.en: Play dxc3, c4, cxb5.
hints.fr: Jouez dxc3, c4, cxb5.
hints.ar: العب dxc3 ثم c4 ثم cxb5.

explain.en: Two captures, one transit: zigzag costs a middle step.
explain.fr: Deux captures, un transit : le zigzag coûte un pas intermédiaire.
explain.ar: التقاطان وعبور واحد: التعرج يكلّف خطوة وسطى.

failHint.en: c3, step, b5: dxc3, c4, cxb5.
failHint.fr: c3, pas, b5 : dxc3, c4, cxb5.
failHint.ar: c3 ثم خطوة ثم b5: dxc3 ثم c4 ثم cxb5.

goalText.en: Capture twice, then march the star home.
goalText.fr: Capturez deux fois, puis ramenez l'étoile.
goalText.ar: التقط مرتين ثم اصعد بالنجمة.

hints.en: Same trail as before — then keep marching.
hints.fr: Même piste qu'avant — puis continuez à monter.
hints.ar: نفس الدرب السابق — ثم واصل الصعود.

hints.en: After b5, single steps only: moved pawns lose the double push.
hints.fr: Après b5, que des petits pas : un pion déplacé perd la double poussée.
hints.ar: بعد b5 خطوات مفردة فقط: البيدق المتحرك يفقد الدفعة المزدوجة.

hints.en: Play dxc3, c4, cxb5, b6, b7.
hints.fr: Jouez dxc3, c4, cxb5, b6, b7.
hints.ar: العب dxc3 ثم c4 ثم cxb5 ثم b6 ثم b7.

explain.en: The double push is one-time-only: plan around single steps after.
explain.fr: La double poussée est unique : prévoyez des petits pas ensuite.
explain.ar: الدفعة المزدوجة لمرة واحدة: خطط لخطوات مفردة بعدها.

failHint.en: dxc3, c4, cxb5, b6, b7.
failHint.fr: dxc3, c4, cxb5, b6, b7.
failHint.ar: dxc3 ثم c4 ثم cxb5 ثم b6 ثم b7.

goalText.en: Push to the last rank, promote, then rule h8.
goalText.fr: Poussez jusqu'au bout, promovez, puis régnez sur h8.
goalText.ar: ادفع حتى الصف الأخير ورقِّ ثم احكم h8.

hints.en: A pawn on its 7th rank is one step from glory.
hints.fr: Un pion au 7e rang est à un pas de la gloire.
hints.ar: البيدق في الصف السابع على بعد خطوة من المجد.

hints.en: Promote first — almost always to queen.
hints.fr: Promovez d'abord — presque toujours en dame.
hints.ar: رقِّ أولًا — غالبًا إلى ملكة.

hints.en: Play a7, a8=Q, Qh8.
hints.fr: Jouez a7, a8=D, Dh8.
hints.ar: العب a7 ثم a8=Q ثم Qh8.

explain.en: Promotion turns your weakest piece into your strongest — then it rules.
explain.fr: La promotion change votre pièce la plus faible en plus forte — puis elle règne.
explain.ar: الترقية تحوّل أضعف قطعك إلى أقواها — ثم تحكم.

success.en: Crowned! From pawn to ruler of h8!
success.fr: Couronné ! De pion à maître de h8 !
success.ar: تُوّجت! من بيدق إلى حاكم h8!

failHint.en: Climb, crown, conquer: a7, a8, h8.
failHint.fr: Montez, couronnez, conquérez : a7, a8, h8.
failHint.ar: اصعد وتوَّج واسُد: a7 ثم a8 ثم h8.

intro.en: Castling tucks the king away and brings a rook to the center. One move does both!

goalText.en: Castle kingside — land the king on g1.

hints.en: The king can jump two squares toward the rook to castle.
Slide the king from e1 to g1 — the rook hops over automatically.
Play Ke1-g1 (written O-O).

explain.en: Castling moves the king two squares toward a rook, and the rook hops to the square the king crossed. It is the only move where two pieces move at once.

success.en: Castled! The king is safe on the wing.

failHint.en: Drag the king from e1 to g1 — not a normal one-square step.

intro.en: Queenside castling sends the king to c1. Same idea, other direction.

goalText.en: Castle queenside — land the king on c1.

hints.en: The king moves toward the a-file rook this time.
Drag the king from e1 to c1.
Play Ke1-c1 (written O-O-O).

explain.en: Queenside castling moves the king to c1 and the a-file rook to d1. It covers three squares the king crosses, so it needs a clear path just like kingside.

success.en: Queenside! The rook lands on d1 ready for action.

failHint.en: Drag the king from e1 toward the queenside rook (c1).

intro.en: You cannot castle through, out of, or into check. The rook eyes g1 — go the other way.

goalText.en: The rook guards g1 — castle queenside to c1 instead.

hints.en: Kingside castling would cross f1 and land on g1 — both attacked by the rook.
Only the queenside path is safe.
Play Ke1-c1 (O-O-O).

explain.en: A king may not castle if it would pass through or land on an attacked square. With a rook firing down the g-file, kingside castling is illegal — queenside is the safe choice.

success.en: Good read — you castled away from the fire.

failHint.en: Kingside is illegal here (through check). Try c1.

intro.en: A pawn that just advanced two squares can be captured as if it moved one. Grab it!

goalText.en: Capture the black pawn on d5 en passant.

hints.en: En passant target squares show up right after a two-square pawn push.
Your e5 pawn captures onto d6 — the square behind the d5 pawn.
Play e5-d6 (exd6 e.p.).

explain.en: When a pawn advances two squares past an enemy pawn, that enemy pawn may capture it on the bypassed square — en passant ("in passing"). The capture lands on the square the pawn skipped.

success.en: En passant! The sneaky pawn capture.

failHint.en: Capture diagonally onto d6, not onto d5 directly.

intro.en: A pawn reaching the last rank becomes any piece. A queen is usually best!

goalText.en: Push the pawn to e8 and promote to a queen.

hints.en: Pawns promote on the 8th rank (for White).
Advance the e7 pawn to e8.
Play e7-e8 and pick the queen.

explain.en: When a pawn reaches the far rank it MUST promote — to a queen, rook, bishop, or knight. The queen, combining rook and bishop power, is the usual choice.

success.en: A new queen! Biggest upgrade on the board.

failHint.en: Move the e7 pawn to e8, then choose the queen.

intro.en: Sometimes promoting ends the game at once. Find the mating promotion.

goalText.en: Promote on e8 — the new queen (or rook) delivers checkmate.

hints.en: The black king is boxed in by its own pawns on f7, g7, h7.
A queen or rook on e8 would check along the open 8th rank.
Play e7-e8 and promote to queen (or rook).

explain.en: Promotion is not just about material — a promoting pawn can deliver the final blow. Here the back rank is weak: a queen (or rook) on e8 checks the trapped king with no escape.

failHint.en: Promote on e8 — a queen or rook both mate here.

intro.en: Most promotions are queens — but not every promotion should be. Here only a knight works.

goalText.en: Promote on e8 — but only a knight completes the goal.

hints.en: The goal demands a knight specifically — the piece type matters.
Advance e7-e8, then pick the knight from the menu.
Play e7-e8 and choose N (underpromotion).

explain.en: Underpromotion means choosing a piece other than a queen. It is rare, but sometimes a knight (the only piece that can fork from a new square) or a rook (avoiding stalemate) is exactly right.

success.en: Underpromotion! Right tool for the job.

failHint.en: Promote to a knight, not a queen.

intro.en: Check attacks the king — it must move (or block/capture). Find any rook check.

goalText.en: Move the rook to give check to the black king.

hints.en: A rook checks by attacking the king along a rank or file.
The e-file leads straight to the black king on e8.
Play Ra1-e1 (or any square on the e-file or 8th rank).

explain.en: Check is an attack on the king. The opponent cannot ignore it — they must capture the attacker, block the line, or move the king. Rooks are natural checkers with their long straight lines.

failHint.en: Land the rook on the e-file or 8th rank to attack the king.

intro.en: Knights give brutal checks — they jump over everything and cannot be blocked.

goalText.en: Jump the knight to give check to the black king.

hints.en: A knight on c7 or d6 would attack the king on e8.
Knights move in an L and cannot be blocked.
Play Nb5-c7 or Nb5-d6.

explain.en: Knight checks are extra dangerous because no piece can block a knight — the king itself must move (or capture). Squares like c7 and d6 are classic knight-check outposts.

failHint.en: Move the knight so it attacks e8 (try c7 or d6).

intro.en: Slide a piece away to uncover a hidden check behind it. Devastating!

goalText.en: Move the knight away to reveal the rook’s check on the king.

hints.en: The rook on e1 already stares at the king — only the knight blocks it.
Any knight move off the e-file unleashes the rook.
Play the e4 knight anywhere (e.g. Ne4-d2).

explain.en: A discovered check happens when one piece moves away and uncovers an attack from a piece behind it. The moving piece is also free to go anywhere — often giving a double threat.

success.en: Discovered check! The hidden rook fires.

failHint.en: Move the knight off the e-file to uncover the rook.

intro.en: The king is trapped behind its own pawns. One rook on the back rank ends it.

goalText.en: Deliver checkmate on the back rank.

hints.en: The black king on g8 is blocked by its own f7, g7, h7 pawns.
A rook on the 8th rank checks with no escape.
Play Re1-e8 (Re8#).

explain.en: The back-rank mate exploits pawns that never advanced, sealing the king’s escape squares. A single rook on the back rank delivers mate. Always be alert for this pattern — for both sides!

failHint.en: Slide the rook to the 8th rank (e8).

intro.en: With a queen and king, herd the lone king to the edge and close the net.

goalText.en: Checkmate the black king with your queen.

hints.en: The queen needs the king’s support to deliver mate safely.
Place the queen on g7 — right next to the king, defended by your king.
Play Qg1-g7 (Qg7#).

explain.en: Queen-and-king mate works by shrinking the enemy king’s space to the edge, then placing the queen adjacent (supported by the king) so it checks with no capture or flight. The queen alone cannot mate — the king must help.

success.en: Queen mate! The net is closed.

failHint.en: Put the queen on g7, defended by your king on g6.

intro.en: The rook mates on the edge while the king takes away the escape squares.

goalText.en: Checkmate the black king with your rook.

hints.en: The king on b6 already covers a7, b7, c7.
A rook on the 8th rank checks the cornered king.
Play Rh1-h8 (Rh8#).

explain.en: Rook-and-king mate forces the enemy king to the edge using the friendly king as a wall, then the rook delivers a distant check along the edge rank or file.

success.en: Rook mate! King and rook teamwork.

failHint.en: Check along the 8th rank with Rh8.

intro.en: A pawn can take away the key escape square. Combine it with the queen.

goalText.en: Checkmate the black king — your pawn covers the flight square.

hints.en: The pawn on g6 covers h7 — the king’s only flight square.
A queen on the 8th rank checks; h7 is taken by the pawn.
Play Qd1-d8 (Qd8#).

explain.en: Mates often need a helper. Here the g6 pawn covers h7, so a queen on d8 checks along the rank with the king boxed between the queen and its own edge — no escape remains.

success.en: Mate with a little pawn help!

failHint.en: Check on the 8th rank (Qd8) — the pawn guards h7.

intro.en: If the opponent has no legal move and is NOT in check, the game is drawn. Sometimes that saves you!

goalText.en: Stalemate the black king (no moves, not in check).

hints.en: Stalemate is NOT check — the queen must cover every flight square without attacking the king.
The king on a8 has squares a7, b7, b8 — cover all three without checking.
Play Qc2-c7 (Qc7 — stalemate).

explain.en: Stalemate: the side to move has no legal move and their king is not in check → draw. A player losing badly can sometimes force stalemate to save half a point. The queen on c7 covers a7, b7, and b8 while leaving the king unstopped but uncheckmated.

failHint.en: Cover a7, b7, b8 with the queen — but do NOT check the king.

intro.en: A hanging piece is undefended. Free material — just grab it.

goalText.en: Capture the undefended black knight on d5.

hints.en: Look for enemy pieces with no defender nearby.
The knight on d5 is guarded by nothing.
Play Bc4xd5.

explain.en: A hanging (undefended) piece can be captured for free. Before every move, scan: can I take something the opponent cannot recapture? Here the knight on d5 sits alone.

failHint.en: Take the knight on d5 with the bishop.

intro.en: Two undefended pieces line up. Take them both.

goalText.en: Capture both hanging black pieces (bishop on d4, knight on d5).

hints.en: Both black pieces sit on the d-file, stacked.
The queen can take them one after the other.
Play Qd1xd4, then Qd4xd5.

explain.en: When several pieces hang, take them in the order that keeps your attacks flowing. Here the queen sweeps the d-file, gobbling the bishop then the knight.

failHint.en: Take the bishop on d4 first, then the knight on d5.

intro.en: A pinned piece cannot move away — it is stuck protecting what is behind it. Win it!

goalText.en: The knight is pinned to the king — capture it.

hints.en: The knight on e5 is pinned against the king on e8 by your rook.
A pinned piece cannot legally move (it would expose its king).
Play Re1-e5 (Rxe5).

explain.en: An absolute pin traps a piece against the king — it has zero legal moves. You can simply win it, because it cannot flee. Here the rook pins the knight to the king along the e-file.

success.en: The pinned knight falls — free material.

failHint.en: The knight on e5 is pinned; take it with the rook.

intro.en: Pins are not only against kings. A piece shielding a queen is also stuck — win it.

goalText.en: The knight is pinned to the queen — capture it.

hints.en: The knight on e5 blocks the rook’s attack on the queen behind it.
Moving the knight would lose the queen — so it stays put.
Capture the knight on e5 with the rook (Rxe5).

explain.en: A relative pin traps a piece against a valuable piece (not the king). The pinned piece can legally move, but doing so loses the piece behind it — effectively stuck. Here the knight guards the queen and pays the price.

failHint.en: Take the pinned knight on e5.

explain.en: Attack two pieces in a line: the front one flees, the back one falls.
One piece attacks two targets at once — the opponent cannot save both.
Capture the piece that guards another, then take the now-defenseless prize.
Force a defender away from the square or piece it must protect.
Lure a piece to a square where it falls victim to a fork, pin, or mate.
Insert an unexpected intermediate move (often a check) before the expected recapture.

intro.en: Knights first! They are slow to the edges and quick to the center.

goalText.en: Develop both knights to c3 and f3.

hints.en: The b1 and g knights aim for c3 and f3.
Knights develop in one jump — no need to clear a path.
Play Nb1-c3, then Ng1-f3.

explain.en: Development means bringing pieces off the back rank into the game. Knights to c3/f3 (or c6/f6 for Black) control central squares and clear the way for castling.

success.en: Both knights developed — nice control of the center.

failHint.en: Land the knights on c3 and f3.

intro.en: Bishops love open diagonals. Point them at the enemy camp.

goalText.en: Develop both bishops to active squares (c4 and f4).

hints.en: Bishops slide diagonally as far as the board allows.
The c1 bishop reaches c4; the f1 bishop reaches f4.
Play Bc1-c4, then Bf1-f4.

explain.en: Developing bishops to active diagonals (often pointing at the opponent’s king) is a core opening goal. On their starting squares they are passive; one move makes them powerful.

failHint.en: Move the bishops to c4 and f4.

intro.en: Pawns in the center (d4/e4 for White) control key squares and free your pieces.

goalText.en: Push your center pawns to d4 and e4.

hints.en: Pawns advance one square (or two from their start).
The d2 and e2 pawns are your central duo.
Play d2-d4 and e2-e4.

explain.en: Central pawns on d4/e4 (or d5/e5) grab space, control key squares, and open diagonals for bishops. Classical openings fight for this center from move one.

success.en: Central pawns established — space and scope.

failHint.en: Advance the d and e pawns two squares each.

intro.en: Rooks belong on open files — lanes with no pawns — where they slice into enemy territory.

goalText.en: Move both rooks to the open d- and e-files.

hints.en: The d- and e-files have no pawns — they are open.
The b1 rook slides to d1; the g1 rook to e1.
Play Rb1-d1 and Rg1-e1.

explain.en: Rooks are strongest on open or half-open files, aiming at the enemy king and pawns. Central files (d, e) are the most prized in the opening and middlegame.

success.en: Both rooks on open files — real pressure.

failHint.en: Place the rooks on d1 and e1.

intro.en: A rook on the 7th rank attacks pawns from behind and cramps the enemy king.

goalText.en: Lift the rook to the 7th rank (a7).

hints.en: The 7th rank is the row just before the enemy’s home rank.
The a-file is clear in front of the rook.
Play Ra1-a7.

explain.en: Rooks on the 7th (or 2nd for Black) are famously strong: they attack the enemy pawns from behind and restrict the king to the back rank. Many attacks are built on a “rook lift” to the 7th.

success.en: Rook established on the 7th — big pressure.

failHint.en: Slide the a1 rook up to a7.

intro.en: A passed pawn has no enemy pawns blocking or guarding its path. Race it home!

goalText.en: March the passed e-pawn up to e7.

hints.en: No black pawn blocks or guards the e-file.
Pawns advance toward the 8th rank — push it!
Play e2-e4, then e4-e5, e5-e6, e6-e7.

explain.en: A passed pawn is a potential queen. In the endgame, pushing passed pawns — supported by the king — is often the whole strategy. Here the e-pawn walks free to the 7th.

success.en: The passed pawn is nearly a queen.

failHint.en: Keep pushing the e-pawn up the board.

intro.en: In the endgame the king becomes a fighter. Bring it to the center!

goalText.en: March your king to the central square e4.

hints.en: The king moves one square in any direction.
Head diagonally toward the middle: b2, c3, d4, e4.
Play Ka1-b2, Kb2-c3, Kc3-d4, Kd4-e4.

explain.en: Early game: hide the king. Endgame: activate it! A centralized king controls squares, supports pawns, and harasses enemy pieces. Walking it to e4 is a model journey.

success.en: King centralized — a real endgame asset.

failHint.en: Walk the king toward the center square e4.

intro.en: With no enemy pieces, just push the pawn to promotion. The king can help if needed.

goalText.en: Push the e-pawn all the way to e8 and promote.

hints.en: The path is clear — no black pieces in the way.
Advance the pawn down the e-file, square by square.
Play e2-e4, e4-e5, e5-e6, e6-e7, e7-e8=Q.

explain.en: In a pure pawn endgame, a passed pawn promotes with no opposition. Push it steadily — every step brings a new queen closer. This is the simplest winning endgame.

failHint.en: Keep pushing the e-pawn toward the 8th rank.

intro.en: Active rooks in the endgame harvest weak pawns. Grab the black pawn.

goalText.en: Use the rook to capture the black pawn on g2.

hints.en: The g-file and 2nd rank both lead to the pawn.
Bring the rook to the 2nd rank first, then take.
Play Ra1-a2, then Ra2-g2.

explain.en: Rook endgames are drawn to activity: an active rook attacks enemy pawns from the side or behind. Here the rook swings to the 2nd rank and collects the loose pawn.

failHint.en: Route the rook to g2 and take the pawn.

intro.en: Two rooks take turns checking along ranks, herding the king to the edge — the ladder.

goalText.en: Checkmate the lone king with two rooks (the ladder).

hints.en: One rook cuts off a rank; the other checks on the next.
First take away the 7th rank, then check on the 8th.
Play Rb1-b7 (cut 7th), then Ra1-a8 (Ra8#).

explain.en: The ladder mate is the fastest way to mate a lone king: one rook seals off a rank while the other checks on the next, pushing the king back rank by rank until the edge delivers mate.

failHint.en: Cut the 7th rank with one rook, mate on the 8th with the other.

intro.en: Losing badly? If you have no pieces left, stalemate can steal a draw. Find it.

goalText.en: Stalemate the black king — secure the half-point.

hints.en: With only a queen left to move, stalemate is your friend.
Cover g8 and h7 without checking the king on h8.
Play Qa1-a2 (Qa2 — stalemate; the queen covers g8, your king covers h7 and g7).

explain.en: When you are lost, check for stalemate tricks: leave the opponent with no legal move and no check. A queen can often force stalemate against a bare king if the defender plays accurately (here, Qa2 — the diagonal covers g8 while the king seals h7 and g7).

success.en: Stalemate! From lost to draw — great save.

failHint.en: Place the queen so it covers g8 and h7 but does not check h8.
